name: comp-52
blurb: Read-only email input displaying non-editable content.
description: An email input with readOnly attribute and muted background styling. Uses read-only: pseudo-class for visual indication.
use_when: Display email addresses or other data that should be visible but not editable.
avoid_when: The content needs to be selectable and copied (better to show plain text).
a11y: Label linked to input. Visually distinct with muted background. Not focusable for editing.
